data.gender_notes: Anji is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anji is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘anjan’ which means ‘graceful, radiant, and beautiful’. It is also associated with the goddess Anjani, the mother of Lord Hanuman in Hindu mythology. The name Anji carries the meaning “Graceful, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anji usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
